note_on_format: Original findings are in ../raw/agent-session-features.md; each entry here carries id, title, category, original_severity, verdict fields.

verdicts.title: Seven hand-rolled generation-guarded backoff timers plus two doubling helpers
verdicts.note: Opened session_attention.go:1400-1510, session.go:1132/1386, session_active_turn.go:171/331, delegate_delivery.go:1032-1131, session_fail_closed.go:133, job_shell.go:720. 16 non-test 'Retry.generation++' sites across 6 timer fields; min(delay*2, ...) at 7 sites (delegate_delivery:1047, attention:1319/1438/1491, active_turn:181/330, session.go:1427). Drift confirmed: stable rail (:1491) doubles s.stableAttentionRetry.delay read at fire time, others double the captured delay; the stable rail comment says this is deliberate (a reset landing while armed must hold). The two backoff helpers are identical loops differing only in constants and are sleep-based, a different mechanism from the AfterFunc timers.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Same helper plan, but the shared type must keep the stable rail's fire-time doubling as an explicit option (test the reset-while-armed case) rather than normalizing it. Do the two sleep-backoff helpers as a separate trivial PR (backoffDelay(attempt, initial, max)). One rail per commit; CI-only test runs.

verdicts.title: drainJobTreeWith is a 484-line state machine
verdicts.note: drainJobTreeWith spans session_jobtree_drain.go:1036-1519 (484 lines). takeDrainWake(wake) is called 5 times in the loop (1121,1241,1288,1388,1430,1480) and the 'if skipKick' guard appears 4 times (1254,1300,1440,1495). Process func type appears 3x in this file, 8 files repo-wide. kickDriveTreeWith (1688) is a one-line adder of true, but is called directly by 3 tests in session_jobtree_drain_seed100_more_test.go, so deleting it needs test edits, not just prod edits.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: As proposed; add that deleting kickDriveTreeWith means updating session_jobtree_drain_seed100_more_test.go:81,88,114. Keep wake-vs-verdict read order untouched; move-then-simplify.

Skip the afero seam change unless the covtest tests are being reorganized anyway.

verdicts.title: Six near-identical ListActivity*/LoadSessionActivity* pairs

verdicts.title: Four independent tail-probe resume implementations
verdicts.note: Overstated. The real near-duplicates are delegateAttentionFoldCursor (session_attention.go:1767: SameFile + size<offset + 4096-byte tail) and sessionActivityIndex.checkSource (session_activity_cursor.go:259: SameFile + size<offset + 64-byte tail via hmac.Equal). foldcache does not use os.SameFile at all; it uses size/mtime/tail with epoch and ambiguity states (foldcache.go:380-430) and is deliberately more elaborate. jobstore fileCursor (store.go:96) is size+mtime based, no tail probe or SameFile. retirementJournalCoherent (session_retirement_evidence.go:301) is a one-line coherence check, not a resume probe. Unifying these under one type would erase intentional semantic differences in cache-correctness code.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Only share a small identity+tail probe between the attention cursor and checkSource if touching them anyway; leave foldcache, jobstore and retirement alone. The extendDelegateAttentionFold prior/fromOffset unused point is real (session_attention.go:164-171) but is a separate perf change, not dedup.

verdicts.title: Test-mode behavior and dead test seams in production types
verdicts.note: testSpeedIO session_init.go:64 gates on testing.Testing(); memoryBoundaryWait session_memory.go:913 picks 30s (905) vs 250ms (904); git_snapshot.go:49 also gates on it. testConfig is session_config.go:318-798 (480 lines); 152 testOnly refs in non-test files. ObserveCloseStopJoin (session_worktree_close.go:307) has zero setters repo-wide (the cmd test comment mentions it but sets only ObserveCloseStopJoinBudget at run_drain_wedged_delegate_test.go:265). CloseStopJoinBudget (:282) has zero callers including tests. Steps 2-3 touch test defaults and conflict-prone product testing policy.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Step 1 as proposed (delete ObserveCloseStopJoin, CloseStopJoinBudget, fix the 'compatibility' doc). Steps 2-3 require discussion with Jesse and CI-only validation; do not bundle.

verdicts.title: session_notes_rpc.go is four files in one with a hand-rolled entity canonicalizer
verdicts.note: 1294 lines; function layout matches claimed regions (mutations 32-400, context render/escape 424-690, committed cut 709-830, projection 831-950, steering/self-echo 963-1294). Canonicalizer helpers span 466-605 (~140 lines); isNotesSelfEchoTurn is 963-1125 (~160). roborev reference at :544 confirmed. verdicts.title: session_model_call.go hosts a second subsystem plus pass-through and dead parameter
verdicts.note: The unused trailing '_ int' on callModelWithFallback is real (session_model_call.go:1211) but ~12 test callers pass it, not 3. budgetModelDispatchRequest (1505) is a legitimate thin discard-the-budget wrapper with 2 callers; budgetModelDispatchRequestWithBudget has 6+ callers that need the budget, so 'drop one of the two' is just inlining a 3-line wrapper, not worthwhile. Responses-continuation function cluster (~18 functions) is real and a verbatim file move is safe.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Move continuation functions to session_responses_continuation.go and drop the '_ int' param (update ~12 test callers). Leave the budget wrapper.

verdicts.title: Retirement blocker categories are raw strings
verdicts.note: Raw-string categories confirmed (counts: notification 7, delegate 8, job 4, autonomous 4, unsupported 4, watch 3, input 2, one each environment/question/turn). But Category is only a display/label field: consumers are server/appwire_daemon.go:92, cmd/evener/serve_log.go:53-56 and hubcore roster hash (roster.go:634); no Go code branches on it, so 'a typo silently never matches' is overstated. The 'unsupported until human acts' framing is also weak: retirementColdJobJournal (evidence.go:340-362) deliberately handles the legitimately absent case and treats lost evidence as unretirable to protect user work.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Optional typed constants for hygiene only; drop step 2 unless Jesse flags a stuck-session case.

verdicts.title: Three control-character strippers plus load-time legacy sanitization
verdicts.note: Three functions exist (session_notes.go:279,319,336). They differ semantically, not just by predicate: stripTextControls keeps '\n', drops '\r', converts whitespace controls to spaces; stripDisplayControls drops all controls; stripNoteControls keeps whitespace controls for later collapse. stripDisplayControls is used only by sanitizeRestoredURLs (session_init.go:1287). stripTextControls has 6+ other callers (diagnostics.go:47, session_notes_rpc.go, session_client_mutation_persist.go:57). Legacy load-time cleanup comment at :295 is real but it is cheap defense on untrusted persisted data.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Low value; ask Jesse about deleting sanitizeRestoredURLs legacy handling, otherwise leave the three strippers.
